User Story: As a customer, I want to view my available wallet balance so that I know how much I can spend.

Summary: Add money using a saved payment method
User Story: As a customer, I want to add money using a saved payment method so that I can fund my wallet quickly.
As a customer, I want to view recent wallet transactions so that I can track my spending.
As a customer, I want to filter transactions by date and type so that I can find a payment easily.
As a customer, I want to pay an approved merchant from my wallet so that checkout is faster.
As a customer, I want a confirmation after a wallet payment so that I know the payment succeeded.
As a customer, I want to set a daily spending limit so that I can control my expenses.
As a customer, I want a notification when my balance falls below my chosen threshold so that I can top up in time.
As a customer, I want an eligible refund credited to my wallet so that I can reuse the refunded amount quickly.
As a customer, I want to see the status of a refund so that I know when the amount will be available.
As a customer, I want to report an unrecognised transaction so that the support team can investigate it.
As a customer, I want to freeze my wallet so that unauthorised use can be prevented.
